C9000357.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 357 (Bi-Lipschitz coordinates at every regular RCD point.; papers: Bi-Lipschitz Coordinates at Regular Points of Noncollapsed RCD Spaces; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

O_MAIN_THEOREM.statement: Verification route only: every regular point in the stated noncollapsed RCD(K,n) setting has an ambient-open dimensionally bi-Lipschitz chart. This remains open in this bounded audit.

O_COORDINATES.statement: Upstream all-center/all-scale harmonic normalization and open harmonic coordinate domain.

O_VALUE_ITERATION.statement: Cumulative matrix comparison and inverse-transpose value-space iteration yield the open bi-Lipschitz chart.

O_POISSON.statement: Imported equal-source Poisson replacements, squared-defect Hessian and gradient estimates.

O_RADIAL_INVARIANCE.statement: Imported summable radial-invariance estimate pi:radial-invariance with a common normalization.

O_COMMUTATOR.statement: The two-center commutator identifies the directional coefficient; its conclusion is not used to prove C_SP.

C_SP.statement: Conditional uniform sharp projection: |b|<=C and ||grad(v-b.U)||_L2(B_(2L+4)(y))<=C sqrt(E_i(x)+E_i(z)).

C_EUL.statement: The affine projection residual satisfies its Euler equation, with forcing coefficients bounded by C(alpha+s).

C_RT.statement: Unnormalized radial transport gives ||w||_L2(B_2R)<=C(alpha+s) without an inverse power of alpha.

C_NORM.statement: Uniform interior harmonic compactness, orthogonality and Euler rigidity imply alpha<=C s.

C_RIG.statement: A C2 Euclidean solution of X.grad h=h+ell.X+k is affine; affine orthogonality forces zero.
